messages.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Monika Zellner,

Thank you for your quote and for specifying the available allocation and lead time. We recognise that constrained capacity makes dependable orders more useful to you than additional forecasts.

Our demand forecast for this part has changed +10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09). Your on-time delivery over the last four quarters was 79.5% (sc:70410@2026Q3).

Our proposal offers a binding annual commitment under a longer agreement, with pricing conditional on explicitly reserved capacity and a confirmed delivery schedule. We are flexible on lead time, including a longer planning window; which option works best for your capacity plan?

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 27.01 per unit, lead time 42 days, 23,400 units per year, 24-month agreement.
Option B: EUR 26.27 per unit, lead time 56 days, 23,400 units per year, 24-month agreement.
Option C: EUR 27.01 per unit, lead time 35 days, 23,400 units per year, 24-month agreement.

Could you send a delivery schedule with the monthly quantities you can commit to?

We look forward to agreeing dependable call-offs that support your capacity planning and our supply requirements.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Furthermore, we checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. 

We acknowledge the increased volume of 23,400 units and the 24-month contract term. Given our high capacity utilization, the 56-day lead time is the most viable option to ensure reliable supply. 

Based on these parameters, we offer a revised price of EUR 31.90 per unit; our logistics team will provide the delivery schedule upon commercial agreement. Our Angebot comprises a price of €31.90 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
